title: Authenticated per-frame Story publication receipts
question: Can each sequential Story have a verifiable platform receipt without exposing private provider state?
hypotheses: An additive typed receipt store and authenticated scoped query closes last-ID-only evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Each confirmed frame records its index and platform ID durably.
Authenticated organization-scoped queries expose only typed receipts, not provider state or credentials.
Partial failures preserve receipts and do not repeat ambiguous publication.
Workflow evolution is versioned and existing in-flight workflows remain unchanged.
evidence: Owner explicitly approved only per-frame receipts through the minimal authenticated interface.
